node.title: Rank-eleven relative correction ten-flat collapse
node.closure: correction-span containment in the ten-dimensional deviation space and elimination of the generic high-dimensional branch
node.statement: In the full-rank H_C branch, every explanation is the descended dense pair line plus a vector in the fixed ten-dimensional deviation space V'. Coefficientwise interpolation is V'-valued after subtracting the pair line, so every correction h_gamma-H(gamma) lies in V'. The correction span has dimension at most 10; dimensions zero and one are paid by the core/ray theorem. Since proper spaces are paid through dimension 11, every over-budget survivor is a positive-dimensional rank-flat or polynomial clone component. Every survivor absorbs all high interpolant coefficients: by clone tolerance through dimension 9, or by W=V' at dimension 10.
